hints.title: Submatrix Element Extraction
hints.text: Extract all k by k elements for each sliding submatrix position.

hints.title: Distinct Sorted Order
hints.text: Sort the elements to bring values with the smallest numerical difference adjacent to each other.

hints.title: Adjacent Pair Scan
hints.text: Scan consecutive unequal sorted values to locate the minimum absolute difference, assigning 0 if all elements are identical.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct sorting of each sliding window.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs comparison per submatrix takes O(k^4).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Temporary sorting vector takes O(k^2) memory per window.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle identical element tie-breaking resulting in zero difference.
